markdown:
I couldn't read pages 121–122, so I have not extracted any headings for them.

The Read tool can't render the pages because `pdftoppm` (part of poppler) isn't installed. The project rules don't allow me to run `brew install`, so I couldn't install it.

There is an existing Docling conversion of this PDF in `data/output/那須烏山市総合計画/`, but I didn't use it. These headings look like they'll serve as the answer key that Docling's hierarchy is checked against, so building them from Docling's own output would make that check meaningless.

To run this again, either:
1. Install poppler yourself on the host (`brew install poppler`), or
2. Read the PDF in an environment that has poppler, such as the Docker container.
